senses.en: to happen at the same time
to be the same or agree

ex.en: My vacation will coincide with my sister's wedding.
ex.zh: 我的假期剛好和我姐姐的婚禮撞在一起。

root.note: 一起落在同一點上 → 同時發生

senses.en: a surprising occurrence of events at the same time without apparent connection

ex.en: By pure coincidence, we booked seats next to each other on the plane.
ex.zh: 純屬巧合，我們在飛機上訂到了相鄰的座位。

root.note: 一起落下 → 巧合

senses.en: happening at the same time or occupying the same space

ex.en: The rise in sales was coincident with the new advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 銷售額上升和新的廣告宣傳剛好同時發生。

root.note: 一起落下的 → 同時發生的

senses.en: to work together with others on a project
to cooperate traitorously with an enemy

ex.en: Students will collaborate in small groups to design a robot.
ex.zh: 學生們將以小組合作的方式設計一台機器人。

root.note: 一起工作 → 合作

senses.en: to fall down or in suddenly
to fail suddenly and completely
a sudden fall or failure

ex.en: The old bridge could collapse under the weight of a heavy truck.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋可能會在重型卡車的重量下倒塌。

root.note: 整個一起塌下 → 倒塌

senses.en: able to be folded into a smaller shape

ex.en: We packed a collapsible table for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 我們帶了一張可摺疊的桌子去露營。

root.note: 可以收起來的

senses.en: a person one works with in a profession or business

ex.en: I asked a colleague to cover my shift while I was sick.
ex.zh: 我生病時請一位同事幫我代班。

parts.m: choose 選（拉丁文 legare 派遣）

root.note: 一起被選派的人 → 同事

senses.en: done by or shared by all members of a group
a business or group owned and run by its members

ex.en: Cleaning up the park was a collective effort by the whole town.
ex.zh: 清理公園是全鎮居民共同努力的成果。

root.note: 收集在一起的 → 集體的

senses.en: a person who collects things as a hobby
a person whose job is to collect money owed

ex.en: The stamp collector paid a fortune for one rare stamp.
ex.zh: 那位集郵家花了一大筆錢買一張稀有郵票。

root.note: 收集東西的人

senses.en: a college student or recent graduate

ex.en: Every collegian in the dorm stayed up late before final exams.
ex.zh: 期末考前，宿舍裡每個大學生都熬夜到很晚。

root.note: 大學裡的人

senses.en: to hit something violently when moving
to come into conflict

ex.en: Two cars will collide if that driver does not slow down.
ex.zh: 如果那位駕駛不減速，兩輛車就會相撞。

root.note: 撞在一起

senses.en: a coal miner
a ship that carries coal

ex.en: The old collier came home every night covered in black dust.
ex.zh: 那位老礦工每天晚上回家時都滿身黑色煤灰。

root.note: 挖煤的人

senses.en: an instance of two things hitting each other
a conflict between opposing ideas or interests

ex.en: No one was hurt in the collision between the two bikes.
ex.zh: 兩輛腳踏車相撞，沒有人受傷。

root.note: 撞在一起 → 碰撞

senses.en: used in ordinary, informal conversation rather than formal writing

ex.en: Avoid colloquial expressions like "kind of" in your formal essay.
ex.zh: 正式作文裡要避免像 kind of 這類口語用法。

root.note: 大家一起說話時用的 → 口語的

senses.en: a word or phrase used in informal speech

ex.en: "Gonna" is a colloquialism that should not appear in a research paper.
ex.zh: gonna 是口語用法，不應出現在研究報告裡。

root.note: 口語的說法

senses.en: a formal conversation or conference

ex.en: The two scholars held a lively colloquy on the future of democracy.
ex.zh: 兩位學者就民主的未來進行了一場熱烈的對談。

root.note: 一起說話 → 對談

senses.en: secret cooperation in order to cheat or deceive others

ex.en: The two companies were fined for collusion in setting prices.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司因勾結聯合定價而被罰款。

root.note: 一起玩把戲 → 勾結

senses.en: a statue much bigger than life size
a person or thing of enormous size, importance, or ability

ex.en: The tech company has grown into a global colossus.
ex.zh: 這家科技公司已經成長為全球性的龐然大物。

parts.m: giant statue 巨像（希臘文 kolossos）

root.note: 古代羅德島太陽神巨像 → 巨人、巨頭

senses.en: pleasant to look at; attractive

ex.en: The old ballad tells of a comely maiden who lived by the sea.
ex.zh: 那首老民謠講述一位住在海邊的美麗少女。

senses.en: an item of food
edible

ex.en: The market sold every comestible you could imagine, from cheese to squid.
ex.zh: 這個市場賣各種你想像得到的食物，從起司到魷魚都有。

root.note: 可以吃的 → 食物

senses.en: amusing, especially in a silly or absurd way

ex.en: The puppy looked comical in its oversized raincoat.
ex.zh: 小狗穿著過大的雨衣，看起來好滑稽。

root.note: 像喜劇一樣的 → 滑稽的

senses.en: to honor and remember an important person or event

ex.en: A statue was built to commemorate the soldiers who died in the war.
ex.zh: 人們建造一座雕像來紀念在戰爭中犧牲的士兵。

root.note: 大家一起記住 → 紀念

senses.en: a spoken description of an event as it happens
a set of explanations or opinions about something

ex.en: The film is a sharp commentary on modern social media.
ex.zh: 這部電影是對現代社群媒體的一番犀利評論。

root.note: 用心思寫下的說明 → 評論、註解

senses.en: to mix or blend together

ex.en: In this city, old traditions and new ideas commingle freely.
ex.zh: 在這座城市裡，古老傳統和新觀念自然地交融在一起。

root.note: 混在一起

senses.en: a military department responsible for supplying food

ex.en: The army's commissariat struggled to feed the troops through the winter.
ex.zh: 軍隊的糧食補給部門在整個冬天都很難讓部隊吃飽。

root.note: 負責運送物資的部門

senses.en: a group of people given official authority to do a task
money paid to a salesperson based on sales
to order or authorize the making of something

ex.en: The museum plans to commission a new mural for its entrance.
ex.zh: 博物館打算委託製作一幅新的壁畫放在入口。

root.note: 把任務交付出去 → 委託、委員會

senses.en: dedication to a cause, activity, or relationship
a promise or obligation

ex.en: Learning a language takes real commitment and daily practice.
ex.zh: 學一種語言需要真正的投入和每天的練習。

root.note: 把自己交付出去 → 投入、承諾

senses.en: the act of sending someone to prison or a hospital
the burial of a body

ex.en: The judge ordered the committal of the suspect to a psychiatric hospital.
ex.zh: 法官下令把嫌犯送進精神病院。

root.note: 把人送去某處

senses.en: a raw material or product that can be bought and sold
a useful or valuable thing

ex.en: Oil is the most traded commodity in the world.
ex.zh: 石油是全世界交易量最大的商品。

root.note: 合用的東西 → 商品

mn: 在很多年輕人眼中，時間是最稀缺的 commodity（資源）。

senses.en: a state of noisy confusion or disturbance

ex.en: We heard a commotion outside and ran to the window.
ex.zh: 我們聽到外面一陣騷動，就跑到窗邊看。

root.note: 大家一起亂動 → 騷動

senses.en: to travel regularly between home and work or school
to reduce a sentence of punishment to a less severe one
a regular journey to and from work

ex.en: Many workers commute to the city by train every day.
ex.zh: 很多上班族每天搭火車通勤到市區。

root.note: 改變、交換 → 減刑；定期換地點 → 通勤

senses.en: similar enough to be compared; roughly equal

ex.en: The two phones have comparable prices and features.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機的價格和功能差不多。

root.note: 可放在一起比的 → 相當的

mn: 重音在第一音節：ˋcomparable，不是 comˋparable。

senses.en: measured or judged by comparison with something else; relative
involving the study of similarities and differences

ex.en: After the storm, the town returned to comparative calm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，小鎮恢復了相對的平靜。

root.note: 放在一起比的 → 相對的

senses.en: the act of examining how two or more things are alike or different

ex.en: In comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
ex.zh: 和去年相比，銷售額增加了一倍。

root.note: 放在一起看是否相等 → 比較

senses.en: to pay someone for loss, injury, or work
to make up for something bad or missing

ex.en: He tried to compensate for his slow start by running faster at the end.
ex.zh: 他試著在最後加速，來彌補起跑太慢。

root.note: 一起秤、使兩邊平衡 → 補償

senses.en: the ability to do something successfully or efficiently

ex.en: Nobody questions her competence as a surgeon.
ex.zh: 沒有人質疑她身為外科醫生的能力。

root.note: 足以一起競爭 → 勝任的能力

senses.en: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well

ex.en: She is a competent driver, even in heavy snow.
ex.zh: 即使在大雪中，她也是個稱職的駕駛。

root.note: 能一起追求的 → 能勝任的

senses.en: involving competition
strongly wanting to win
as good as or better than others

ex.en: Getting into a top university has become extremely competitive.
ex.zh: 進入頂尖大學已經變得極為競爭。

root.note: 一起追求同一目標 → 競爭的

senses.en: a person or company that competes against others

ex.en: Each competitor must finish the race within three hours.
ex.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在三小時內跑完全程。

root.note: 一起追求的人 → 競爭者

senses.en: self-satisfaction combined with unawareness of danger

ex.en: Complacence after one success can lead to failure next time.
ex.zh: 一次成功後的自滿，可能導致下一次的失敗。

root.note: 對自己非常滿意 → 自滿

senses.en: willingness to please others or to accept their wishes

ex.en: His complaisance made him popular, but he rarely stood up for himself.
ex.zh: 他的隨和讓他很受歡迎，但他很少為自己爭取。

root.note: 想讓別人高興 → 殷勤順從

senses.en: willing to please others; obliging

ex.en: The complaisant clerk agreed to every change the customer requested.
ex.zh: 那位殷勤的店員答應了顧客提出的每一項更改。

root.note: 一心讓人高興的 → 殷勤的

mn: complaisant 想讓別人滿意；complacent 是對自己滿意。

senses.en: made of many connected parts; complicated
[ˋkɑmplɛks] a group of related buildings
[ˋkɑmplɛks] an emotional problem or obsession

ex.en: Climate change is a complex problem with no simple solution.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷是個複雜的問題，沒有簡單的解方。

root.note: 交織在一起 → 複雜的

senses.en: willing to obey or agree to others' wishes
meeting rules or standards

ex.en: All new cars must be compliant with the safety regulations.
ex.zh: 所有新車都必須符合安全規範。

root.note: 滿足要求的 → 順從的、合規的

senses.en: to make something more difficult or confusing

ex.en: Please don't complicate the plan by adding more stops.
ex.zh: 請不要再增加停靠點，讓計畫變得更複雜。

root.note: 摺在一起 → 使複雜

senses.en: something that makes a situation more difficult
a secondary medical problem that makes an illness worse

ex.en: The surgery went smoothly without any complication.
ex.zh: 手術進行得很順利，沒有出現任何併發症。

root.note: 摺在一起、糾纏 → 複雜因素、併發症

senses.en: involvement with others in a crime or wrongdoing

ex.en: The guard denied any complicity in the robbery.
ex.zh: 警衛否認與這起搶案有任何共謀關係。

root.note: 被摺進同一件事 → 共謀

senses.en: a polite expression of praise or admiration
[ˋkɑmpləˏmɛnt] to politely praise someone

ex.en: She blushed when he paid her a compliment on her singing.
ex.zh: 他稱讚她歌唱得好時，她臉紅了。

mn: complIment 是「I」說好話稱讚你；complEment 讓東西完整（complEte）。

senses.en: a part of a larger whole, especially of a machine

ex.en: Trust is an essential component of any healthy relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何健康關係中不可或缺的要素。

root.note: 放在一起組成整體的東西 → 成分

senses.en: to behave in a particular way
to agree or be consistent with

ex.en: Players are expected to comport themselves with dignity on and off the field.
ex.zh: 球員無論在場內外都應該舉止得體。

root.note: 帶著自己 → 舉止

senses.en: the state of being calm and in control of oneself

ex.en: Even when the crowd booed, the speaker kept her composure.
ex.zh: 即使群眾噓聲四起，演講者依然保持鎮定。

root.note: 把自己擺好、收拾整齊 → 沉著

senses.en: able to be understood

ex.en: The teacher made the difficult theory comprehensible to beginners.
ex.zh: 老師讓初學者也能理解這個艱深的理論。

root.note: 可以抓住的 → 可理解的

senses.en: the ability to understand something

ex.en: The reading comprehension section is the hardest part of the test.
ex.zh: 閱讀理解是這個考試最難的部分。

root.note: 完全抓住意思 → 理解

senses.en: including all or nearly all elements or aspects

ex.en: The guidebook gives a comprehensive list of museums in Paris.
ex.zh: 這本旅遊指南列出了巴黎博物館的完整清單。

root.note: 全部一把抓住 → 全面的

senses.en: to press or squeeze into a smaller space
[ˋkɑmprɛs] a pad pressed on the body to stop bleeding or reduce swelling

ex.en: You can compress the files to save space on your computer.
ex.zh: 你可以壓縮檔案以節省電腦的空間。

root.note: 壓在一起 → 壓縮

senses.en: able to be pressed into a smaller space

ex.en: Gases are compressible, but liquids hardly change in volume.
ex.zh: 氣體可以壓縮，但液體的體積幾乎不變。

root.note: 可以壓在一起的

senses.en: the act of pressing something into a smaller space

ex.en: Video compression lets us stream movies without long delays.
ex.zh: 影片壓縮技術讓我們能串流看電影而不用等很久。

root.note: 壓在一起 → 壓縮

senses.en: to consist of; to be made up of
to make up or form a whole

ex.en: The committee will comprise five teachers and three parents.
ex.zh: 委員會將由五位老師和三位家長組成。

root.note: 一起拿在手中 → 包含

mn: 傳統用法是 A comprises B（A 包含 B），不說 is comprised of，但後者已很常見。

senses.en: a strong, irresistible urge to do something
the act of forcing someone to do something

ex.en: She felt a compulsion to check her phone every few minutes.
ex.zh: 她有一種每隔幾分鐘就想看手機的強烈衝動。

root.note: 用力推動 → 強迫、衝動

senses.en: required by law or rules; mandatory

ex.en: Physical education is compulsory for all first-year students.
ex.zh: 體育課是所有一年級學生的必修課。

root.note: 被強力推著做 → 強制的

senses.en: a feeling of guilt that prevents or follows doing something wrong

ex.en: He lied to his friends without the slightest compunction.
ex.zh: 他對朋友說謊，一點也不內疚。

root.note: 良心被刺痛 → 內疚

senses.en: to calculate a figure or amount

ex.en: The app can compute your total bill including tax and tip.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以計算含稅和小費的總金額。

root.note: 一起算 → 計算（computer 同源）

senses.en: to admit that something is true, often unwillingly
to give up or yield, as in a game or election

ex.en: The candidate had to concede defeat late on election night.
ex.zh: 候選人在選舉之夜很晚時不得不承認落敗。

root.note: 完全讓步 → 承認、認輸

senses.en: excessive pride in oneself
a clever or elaborate comparison in literature

ex.en: His conceit made it hard for him to accept any criticism.
ex.zh: 他的自負讓他很難接受任何批評。

root.note: 原指「想法」→ 對自己的過高想法 → 自負

senses.en: to form an idea or plan in the mind
to become pregnant

ex.en: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
ex.zh: 很難想像一個沒有網路的世界。

root.note: 把想法抓進腦中 → 構想；把胎兒懷在身體裡 → 懷孕

senses.en: a musical work for one or more solo instruments and an orchestra

ex.en: The young violinist performed a Mozart concerto with the orchestra.
ex.zh: 那位年輕小提琴家和管弦樂團合奏了一首莫札特協奏曲。

parts.m: agreement, harmony 協調（義大利文）

root.note: 獨奏與樂團協調演出 → 協奏曲

senses.en: something given up or allowed in order to reach agreement
a reduced price for certain groups
the right to sell goods in a certain place

ex.en: The union agreed to a pay freeze as a concession to save jobs.
ex.zh: 工會同意凍薪，作為保住工作機會的讓步。

root.note: 讓步（concede 的名詞）

senses.en: to stop someone from being angry; to win over

ex.en: The manager offered a free meal to conciliate the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提供一頓免費餐點來安撫生氣的顧客。

parts.m: council, bring together 召集、會議

root.note: 把人們召集在一起 → 調解、安撫

senses.en: intended to make someone less angry

ex.en: After the argument, she sent him a conciliatory text message.
ex.zh: 吵架之後，她傳了一則求和的簡訊給他。

root.note: 想讓雙方重聚的 → 和解的

senses.en: serving to prove a case; ending doubt

ex.en: The DNA test provided conclusive proof of his innocence.
ex.zh: DNA 檢驗提供了證明他清白的確鑿證據。

root.note: 把爭議完全關上 → 決定性的

senses.en: agreement or harmony between people or groups
a treaty

ex.en: The neighbors have lived in concord for decades.
ex.zh: 這些鄰居幾十年來相處和睦。

root.note: 心在一起 → 和諧

senses.en: an alphabetical index of the words in a book or author's works
agreement

ex.en: The scholar used a concordance to find every time Shakespeare used the word "love."
ex.zh: 學者利用語詞索引，找出莎士比亞每一次使用 love 這個字的地方。

root.note: 一致 → 把相同字詞彙整在一起的索引

senses.en: to agree with an opinion
to happen at the same time

ex.en: Most experts concur that the drug is safe.
ex.zh: 多數專家都同意這種藥是安全的。

root.note: 一起跑向同一方向 → 同意

senses.en: agreement
the fact of two or more things happening at the same time

ex.en: The plan cannot go ahead without the concurrence of the board.
ex.zh: 沒有董事會的同意，這個計畫無法進行。

root.note: 一起跑 → 同意、同時發生

senses.en: existing or happening at the same time

ex.en: He is serving two concurrent sentences of five years each.
ex.zh: 他同時服兩個各五年的刑期。

root.note: 一起跑的 → 同時的

senses.en: a temporary brain injury caused by a blow to the head
a violent shock, as from an explosion

ex.en: The football player suffered a concussion during the game.
ex.zh: 那名美式足球員在比賽中發生腦震盪。

root.note: 猛烈撞擊搖晃 → 腦震盪

senses.en: water that forms on a cold surface when warm air cools
the act of making something shorter or denser

ex.en: Condensation formed on the outside of the cold glass.
ex.zh: 冰涼的杯子外面凝結了一層水珠。

root.note: 變得濃密 → 凝結、濃縮

senses.en: to make shorter or more concise
to change from a gas into a liquid

ex.en: Can you condense your ten-page report into one paragraph?
ex.zh: 你可以把十頁的報告濃縮成一段嗎？

root.note: 使變濃密 → 濃縮

senses.en: to act in a way that shows one feels superior to others
senses.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待

senses.en: to do something one considers beneath one's dignity

ex.en: Good teachers never condescend to their students.
ex.zh: 好老師從不對學生擺出高高在上的姿態。

root.note: 從高處爬下來 → 屈尊、擺架子

senses.en: an expression of sympathy, especially when someone has died

ex.en: Please accept my deepest condolence on the loss of your father.
ex.zh: 令尊過世，請接受我最深切的慰問。

root.note: 一起悲傷 → 弔唁

mn: 常用複數片語 offer one's condolences（表達慰問）。

senses.en: to help to bring about a result

ex.en: Regular sleep and exercise conduce to good health.
ex.zh: 規律的睡眠和運動有助於身體健康。

root.note: 一起引向某結果 → 有助於

senses.en: making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible

ex.en: A noisy dorm is not conducive to studying.
ex.zh: 吵雜的宿舍不利於讀書。

root.note: 引向好結果的 → 有助於

mn: 固定搭配 be conducive to：有助於。

senses.en: able to conduct heat or electricity

ex.en: Copper is highly conductible, so it is used in electrical wires.
ex.zh: 銅的傳導性很好，所以被用在電線中。

root.note: 能引導（電、熱）通過的

senses.en: a channel or pipe for carrying water or protecting wires
a person or organization that passes things between others

ex.en: The charity acts as a conduit for donations to disaster victims.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體是把捐款轉交給災民的管道。

root.note: 引導東西通過的通道

senses.en: sweets and candy considered as a group
a shop that sells sweets

ex.en: The window of the confectionery was filled with colorful chocolates.
ex.zh: 糖果店的櫥窗擺滿了五顏六色的巧克力。

root.note: 把材料一起做成的甜食

senses.en: a league or alliance of states or groups
(the Confederacy) the southern states that left the U.S. in 1860–61

ex.en: The tribes formed a loose confederacy to defend their lands.
ex.zh: 這些部落組成一個鬆散的聯盟來保衛土地。

root.note: 一起立約 → 聯盟

senses.en: a person one works with, especially secretly or illegally; an accomplice
joined by an agreement or treaty
[kənˋfɛdəˏret] to bring into an alliance

ex.en: The thief escaped with the help of a confederate waiting in a car.
ex.zh: 小偷在車上等候的同夥協助下逃走了。

root.note: 一起立約的人 → 同夥

senses.en: to discuss something together in order to decide
to give a title, degree, or right

ex.en: The university will confer an honorary degree on the scientist.
ex.zh: 大學將頒授榮譽學位給那位科學家。

root.note: 把意見帶到一起 → 商議；把榮譽帶給人 → 授予

senses.en: a person who attends a conference
a person on whom something is conferred

ex.en: Each conferee received a name badge and a schedule at the door.
ex.zh: 每位與會者在門口都領到名牌和議程表。

root.note: 參與商議或被授予的人

senses.en: a priest who hears confessions
a person to whom one tells secrets

ex.en: The old priest had been the village confessor for forty years.
ex.zh: 那位老神父在村裡聽告解已經四十年了。

root.note: 聽人坦白的人

senses.en: a person one trusts with private matters

ex.en: My older sister has always been my closest confidant.
ex.zh: 我姐姐一直是我最親密的知己。

root.note: 完全信任的人 → 知己

mn: 別和 confident（有自信的）搞混；confidant 重音在最後。

senses.en: to tell someone a secret because you trust them

ex.en: She decided to confide in her teacher about the bullying.
ex.zh: 她決定向老師吐露被霸凌的事。

root.note: 完全信任對方 → 吐露心事

senses.en: belief in one's own abilities
trust in someone or something
a secret told to someone

ex.en: Practice will give you the confidence to speak in public.
ex.zh: 練習會給你在公開場合說話的自信。

root.note: 完全的信任 → 信心

senses.en: feeling sure about oneself or about something

ex.en: I am confident that we will finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 我確信我們會準時完成這個專案。

root.note: 充滿信任的 → 有自信的

senses.en: the state of being kept in a closed space, such as a prison
the period around giving birth

ex.en: The prisoner spent a month in solitary confinement.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯被單獨監禁了一個月。

root.note: 限制在界線內 → 監禁

senses.en: to take someone's property with authority, often as punishment

ex.en: Teachers may confiscate phones that are used during class.
ex.zh: 老師可以沒收上課時使用的手機。

root.note: 收進國庫 → 沒收

senses.en: a large, destructive fire
a large-scale conflict or war

ex.en: A small spark grew into a conflagration that destroyed the forest.
ex.zh: 一點小火星演變成一場燒毀整片森林的大火。

root.note: 猛烈燃燒 → 大火

senses.en: the place where two rivers join
a coming together of people or things

ex.en: The city was built at the confluence of two great rivers.
ex.zh: 這座城市建在兩條大河的匯流處。

root.note: 流到一起 → 匯流

senses.en: flowing together or merging

ex.en: The two confluent streams form a wide river below the hill.
ex.zh: 兩條匯流的小溪在山下形成一條寬闊的河。

root.note: 流在一起的

senses.en: similar in form or nature; consistent
willing to obey or conform

ex.en: The new rules should be conformable to the national standards.
ex.zh: 新的規定應該與國家標準相符。

root.note: 形狀可以一致的 → 相符的
